RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, the July 19, 2002/Asadha 28, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministries:  Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Environment and Forests;
Food Processing Industries; Human Resource Development; Ocean Development;
Railways; Science and Technology; Steel; Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions—138

WIN2\SESSION\RS1899.PM5 71
Central team to assess drought in A.P.
303. SHRI C. RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether a Central team visited
Andhra Pradesh in the month of May, 2002,
to assess the impact of drought in the State;
(b) if so, which districts the team visited
and discussed the problems with concerned
officials;
(c) whether the team has submitted its
report; and
(d) if so, the action taken on the report?
Drought in Andhra Pradesh
304. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) the number and details of the districts
and blocks affected by drought in Andhra
Pradesh, during the current year;
(b) whether the State had sought any
additional Central assistance in cash and kind
in the wake of drought;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) the action taken thereon; and
(e) the current status of drought in the
State?
Maize production in A.P.
305. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) the annual production of Maize in
Andhra Pradesh during the last three years,
year-wise;
(b) how it compares with other major
maize growing States of the country; and
(c) what steps Government have taken
to increase production of Maize in the State?
Drought in M.P.
†306. SHRI SURESH PACHOURI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Madhya Pradesh
Government has sent a memorandum to the
Central Government to tackle the prevailing
drought situation in the State;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and

(c) whether any amount has been
sanctioned so far by Government from the
National Calamity Relief Fund to the State;
if so, the details thereof and if not, the reasons
for the delay?
Decline in productivity of major crops
†307. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn towards the decline in
productivity of major cash crops during the
last three years, including cotton, sugarcane,
wheat and rice;
(b) if so, the State-wise per hectare
production rate of the said crops during
1998-99 and 2000-2001;
(c) if so, the concrete steps taken by
Government to control such situation; and
(d) if no step has been taken the reasons
therefor?
Research Bank by ICAR for grains
†308. SHRI JANESHWAR MISHRA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Indian Council of
Agricultural Research has set up a Research
Bank, in collaboration with the International
Genetic Organisation, to save the species of
grains becoming extinct and to maintain their
reharvesting;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that the farmers
have not been involved in such kind of
researches;
(d) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(e) whether Government would adopt
any policy for providing such information
to the farmers?
Krishi Shiksha Vistar Yojana in
Chhattisgarh
†309. SHRI RAMDHAR KASHYAP:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Chhattisgarh Government
has forwarded a proposal to the Centre,
demanding a sum of Rs. 151.5 crore for
Krishi Shiksha Vistar Yojana; and
(b) if so, the details of action taken so far
in this regard?
Development of aquatic animals in
M.P.
†310. SHRI SURESH PACHOURI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have granted
administrative approval for implementation
of continual sanctioned scheme for
development of aquatic animals for the year
2001-2002 to Madhya Pradesh; and
(b) if so, by when Centre’s share of
Rs. 151.826 lakhs would be released, as
per the demand of the State?
Invention of sowing equipment
†311. DR. ABRAR AHMED: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have invented
any tractor without engine, to be driven by
bullocks rather than diesel to be made
available to farmers at cheaper rates, in order
to provide state-of-the-art sowing plants;
and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Improving the agricultural sector
†312. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a major stress
was given by Government in the budget
speech 2002-2003 on improvement of the
agro sector;
(b) if so, the effective measures taken by
Government in this regard, so far; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
